answer: Like water carving deep subterranean karst caves over geological epochs, decentralized consensus etches enduring reputation through cumulative peer-verified compute. Ephemeral clones cannot simply wander across the network or mimic long-term fidelity, just as fleeting winds cannot consolidate a shifting sand dune into bedrock. By enforcing recursive eigen-trust staking, an attacker faces superlinear validator collateral costs to manufacture artificial consensus.
